page.emptyHint: A story is told here: a premise, the episodes it is told in, and the film it becomes
page.stepComing: This step is not built yet
page.saveConflict: The project was changed somewhere else; reload before leaving
page.saveFailed: The project could not be saved; staying here

side.label: Stories
side.title: Stories
side.nameTooLong: A name is at most {{max}} characters
side.limit: A project tells at most {{max}} stories

remove.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
remove.body: {{chapters}} chapters, {{acts}} acts, {{pictures}} pictures, {{videos}} clips, and {{voices}} voices will no longer be referred to by this story
remove.keeps: The files stay in the shelf, and the timeline it assembled stays in the cutting room

models.label: This step asks
models.parallelTip: Up to {{max}} generations against one model at once; each model has its own queue

stepHint.idea: Say what the story is about, and how long it runs
stepHint.outline: Break the premise into the episodes it is told in
stepHint.elements: Find the characters, places, and things the story needs, and draw them
stepHint.storyboard: Write each episode's acts and shots, then draw them and film them
stepHint.edit: Lay the acts down on a timeline, render the film, and hand a cut of it to the cutting room

confirm.gapIdea: The premise is not written yet: write at least {{min}} characters, or load a manuscript
confirm.gapNoChapters: There are no chapters yet: set how many episodes and write them
confirm.gapChapters: {{count}} chapters still have no title or text (chapter {{list}})
confirm.gapNoElements: Nothing has been found to tell it with yet: read the chapters, or add an element yourself
confirm.gapNoActs: There is no board yet: write one episode's board, or add an act yourself
confirm.gapNoShots: {{count}} acts have no shots: every act needs at least one
confirm.gapFrames: {{count}} shots have no frame drawn yet
confirm.gapNoTimeline: The clips have not been assembled onto a timeline yet

apply.outline: Write the chapters from the model
apply.elements: Write the elements from the model
apply.elementsMerge: Merge what the parts said about the same name
apply.storyboard: Write the board from the model

history.sound: Choose the sound of an act
history.importCanvas: Import the story into a canvas
history.importClips: Import the story into the cutting room

parse.failed: That answer did not read as a chapter table

jobs.done: {{count}} answers were written into the story
jobs.failed: {{failed}} of {{total}} pieces did not come back
jobs.nothingToAsk: There is nothing to ask for here yet
jobs.voiceMissing: Some characters have no voice yet: fill in the Tone on their cards in the Elements step, or set a machine default in the preferences
jobs.referenceMissing: Some characters still need a reference recording: pick one on their cards in the Elements step
jobs.targetGone: {{label}} is no longer in the story
jobs.storyGone: The story this batch was told for is gone
jobs.unreadableAnswer: The answer to {{at}} could not be read; it is kept for you to fix
jobs.answerNotes: {{at}} came back with something left unread: {{notes}}
jobs.mergeMissing: These names were no longer in the cast when the merge landed, and their descriptions were left out: {{names}}
jobs.failedWith: {{failed}} of {{total}} pieces did not come back: {{reason}}
jobs.lookFailed: Could not read the batches through: {{reason}}

idea.lead: Say what the story is about, and how long it runs. Everything after this is written from here.
idea.writePlaceholder: Eleven at night, and the last train stops at a platform it has no business stopping at…
idea.badType: That is not a text file. Turn it into a .txt first.
idea.tooBig: That file is larger than 8 MB
idea.tooLong: That manuscript is longer than a story will hold
idea.chapterShorter: Half a minute shorter per episode
idea.chapterLonger: Half a minute longer per episode
idea.chapterLengthHint: The total stays; the episode count follows this length
idea.durationHint: About {{chapters}} episodes of {{minutes}} min each; the film runs {{duration}}
idea.genreHint: Written into the outline, the elements and the board
idea.styleHint: Written into every picture prompt, which is what the pictures look like
idea.styleHintMissing: Without a genre and a look, the prompts ask for them plainly
idea.afterOutline: Changing the premise does not re-split the chapters by itself — the outline step has “split again”
idea.needsIdea: Write a premise, or load a manuscript

outline.lead: Break the premise into the episodes it is told in, or cut a manuscript at its own chapter and scene divisions — every chapter keeps its text, which you can edit afterwards; the uploaded file is released once it has been cut. Nothing is filmed until you say so.
outline.modeSplitLocked: Load a manuscript first, in the step before this one
outline.chaptersHint: About {{minutes}} minutes an episode; the film runs {{duration}}
outline.splitHint: Cut at the manuscript's own chapters and scenes; the film runs {{duration}}
outline.splitWillAsk: Cuts at the manuscript's own chapters
outline.slow: The model is taking its time; you can stop it
outline.title: Episode title
outline.synopsisHint: {{used}} characters; a paragraph of {{low}}–{{high}} is enough
outline.durationBoard: A board already made for this episode keeps its own lengths
outline.resplitBody: The words of {{chapters}} chapters are written over, and the boards of {{acts}} acts go with them
outline.resplitBodySplit: The words of {{chapters}} chapters are written over; a chapter keeps its board while it stands in the same place, and chapters the new cut leaves out go with theirs
outline.resplitKeeps: The drawings and the clips stay on the shelf, and the timeline it assembled stays in the cutting room
outline.splitting: Finding the cuts in batch {{part}}; {{found}} chapters so far
outline.splitDone: The manuscript was cut into {{count}} chapters
outline.splitNoSource: The manuscript is no longer on file; load it again
outline.splitNoAnswer: the model did not answer with readable chapter positions
outline.splitNoBoundary: no chapter opening in this batch could be located
outline.splitTooManyParts: the manuscript needs too many batches; raise the characters per batch
outline.chapterGone: That chapter is no longer in the story; split it again
outline.splitSourceOutside: The manuscript is not stored inside this project; load it again
outline.insertChapter: Insert a chapter after this one
outline.deleteBody: Chapter {{number}}, “{{title}}”, will be taken out of the story.
outline.deleteActs: The board of {{acts}} acts goes with it; the drawings and clips stay on the shelf.
outline.chapterLimit: This story already holds as many chapters as it can ({{max}})
outline.sourceReleased: The manuscript has been cut and released; load it again in the previous step to split it once more
outline.sourceKeepFailed: The chapters are written, but the manuscript file could not be released: {{reason}}

panels.removeOld: Throw an old drawing of {{label}} away
panels.removeNote: The file is taken off the shelf for good, and that cannot be undone. One the project still uses elsewhere is only removed from the story.
panels.removeKept: The file is still used elsewhere, so it stays on the shelf
panels.removeUnsettled: The change has not been saved yet, so the file stays on the shelf
panels.removeGone: That drawing is no longer in the list
panels.removeFailed: The file could not be removed: {{reason}}
panels.libraryEmpty: The project holds no pictures yet
panels.fileFailed: The file could not be added

inspector.label: {{name}}'s reference
inspector.emptyHint: Draw one, or bring one in from the shelf or this computer

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.note: Edits the current version; the result joins as a new version and the old one stays
edit.pickModel: Choose a model that can edit
edit.capabilitiesUnknown: The model's capabilities are not known yet; a whole-picture edit can still be tried, and repainting a region cannot
edit.modelReady: This model takes a picture as input
edit.noInput: This model takes no picture input; choose one that supports editing
edit.noMask: This model only takes whole-picture edits
edit.placeholder: For example: make the coat dark grey and keep everything else
edit.maskPrompt: Mark the region to change first
edit.noSource: This place has no picture yet; draw one before editing it

elements.lead: What the telling is made of, one card each — the characters it follows, the places it happens in, and the things that matter to it
elements.merging: Merging the names the parts repeated…
elements.leaveTitle: The elements reading is still out
elements.leaveBody: Leaving now drops the batches that have not been sent yet, and the merge that follows them. Batches already sent keep running and their answers still land in the story.
elements.recogniseBody: The chapters are read again for the characters, places and things in them. The {{count}} elements the story holds are matched by name: one the new reading does not find is taken out of the story, description and all.
elements.recogniseNote: No picture is ever deleted — an element that leaves takes its drawings out of the cast, and the files stay on the shelf
elements.empty: Nothing has been read out of the chapters yet
elements.newReferenceNote: The picture becomes a new element of the story and joins this act's cast
elements.name: Name
elements.turnaroundFour: Head, front, side and back on one sheet
elements.needMainFirst: Draw the main picture first — the four views are made from it
elements.rewriteText: Every picture of it is drawn from this description
elements.removeBody: {{name}} leaves the cast. Where a board names it, the reference is left standing as a gap.
elements.removeNote: Nothing on the shelf is deleted: the pictures drawn of it stay among the files
elements.narratorTip: Narrator: lines that belong to nobody are read in it, and every character falls back to it
elements.voiceModelNone: The narrator, this machine, or the deployment's default
elements.voiceReferenceMissing: This file is no longer in the project
elements.voiceReferenceEmpty: The project holds no sounds yet
elements.voiceReferenceHint: Cloning models read the lines in this recording's voice
elements.voiceMannerTip: How this character likes to say things
elements.voiceTryFailed: The try-out did not come back
elements.voiceTryNoVoice: This card has no voice yet: fill in its Tone, or set a machine default in the preferences
elements.voiceTryNoReference: This model reads only a voice it hears: give it a reference recording
elements.voiceOrphan: This machine does not have that model
elements.voiceOrphanNote: This machine does not have that model; lines fall back to the next layer
elements.voiceLines: Lines this character says in the story: {{count}}
elements.bulkDeleteBody: The {{count}} elements leave the cast. Where a board names them, the reference is left standing as a gap.
elements.reorderHint: Drag a row by its handle, or use the arrows beside it. Every move is saved as you go.

storyboard.lead: One episode at a time: which shots an act is made of and how each is filmed, then a frame for every shot and a clip for every act
storyboard.noChapters: This telling has no chapters yet. Split it into episodes in the outline first.
storyboard.soundReady: This episode has sound: it goes on the timeline with the clips when the film is assembled
storyboard.granularityDefaultHint: Acts without a choice of their own film this way; each act card can say otherwise
storyboard.granularityBody: The {{count}} clips already made stay on the shelf, but the fifth step assembles only the ones made {{to}}
storyboard.granularityNote: The two kinds of clip are kept apart, so switching back and forth loses nothing
storyboard.maxRefsHint: How many of a shot's mentioned reference pictures travel with its ask, 0 to 9
storyboard.newReferenceHint: Draw a new reference and add it to this act as an element
storyboard.notCarried: {{name}} is past the reference limit, so its picture does not travel
storyboard.extraNoteHint: What it is and where to use it (optional)
storyboard.extraCarried: This picture travels with the ask
storyboard.extraNotCarried: Past the reference limit, so it does not travel
storyboard.extraLimit: A shot may carry at most {{max}} extra references
storyboard.mentionUndrawn: {{name}} has no picture yet — the words stand in
storyboard.mentionUnknown: No element is called {{name}} — the words stand in
storyboard.generateAll: Write the boards of every episode ({{count}})
storyboard.regenerateBody: The {{acts}} acts it holds now are replaced. The {{drawn}} frames and {{filmed}} clips already made stay on the shelf, but this episode no longer names them.
storyboard.regenerateNote: An act in the same place keeps its pictures and clips and only has its words replaced
storyboard.empty: This episode has no board yet
storyboard.removeActBody: “{{name}}” and its {{count}} shots leave the board. The pictures and clips already made stay on the shelf.
storyboard.removeActNote: The telling is put together without it next time; a clip it left on a timeline comes off at the next assembly
storyboard.splitHint: This act is filmed in pieces, one per shoot role: a run of references is one piece, while a first frame and a first-and-last pair each open their own. A piece longer than {{max}} seconds is cut again at its shots, and the pieces play as one act.
storyboard.clampHint: A clip is filmed in whole seconds, and one runs at most {{max}} seconds
storyboard.noShots: Write a few shots into this act first
storyboard.refGone: This element has left the story
storyboard.filmRoleHint: How this frame is used when the act is shot: a first frame opens a piece of its own, a first-and-last frame pairs with the next, and references are shot as one piece together
storyboard.filmRoleSettled: Used as the closing frame of the piece before it, so it does not open one of its own
storyboard.guessed: The model said “{{from}}”, which is not one it knows — the default is standing in
storyboard.noDialogue: Nothing is said in this shot
storyboard.speaker: Speaker
storyboard.staleRefHint: {{names}} was redrawn after this frame; you can draw it again from the new reference
storyboard.redrawStaleHint: Only the frames whose references changed; the old pictures stay among their versions
storyboard.clipStaleHint: The frame changed after this clip was made; you can film it again, and the old clip still plays
storyboard.missingRef: {{names}} have no picture yet, so they travel with no reference
storyboard.noRefs: No reference pictures at all: the frames are drawn from the words alone
storyboard.undrawnHint: An element with no picture is not among the references: draw it in step three and the frame will hold to it
storyboard.drawEveryFrame: Draw every frame first — a clip is made from the pictures
storyboard.insertShotHere: Insert a shot above this one

edit.lead: Lay the acts end to end as one timeline, render it whole, and hand it to the cutting room
edit.summary: {{name}} · {{count}} clips filmed ({{seconds}}s), laid end to end in episode and act order
edit.summaryByShot: {{name}} · {{count}} clips filmed ({{seconds}}s), laid end to end in episode, act and shot order
edit.soundNote: The voice-over and the music go on rows of their own, under the pictures.
edit.withSubtitles: Write the lines as a caption track
edit.noLines: Nothing is said in this telling yet
edit.subtitlesNote: A caption sits where the shot was planned to run; a clip that came back a different length leaves the words where they are
edit.nothingToAssemble: No clip has been filmed yet — make the acts first
edit.assetMissing: The material of {{place}} has left the project; film it again
edit.noDuration: The material of {{place}} was never measured; the planned length is used
edit.lineOverrun: A reading runs {{over}}s past its shot in {{place}}
edit.lineUnmeasured: A reading in {{place}} was never measured; it is laid at its shot's own length
edit.rebuildTitle: {{count}} clips on this timeline are not this story's
edit.rebuildBody: Assembling again leaves them alone, but the clips this story laid down are rearranged
edit.noTimeline: The timeline is gone; assemble the film again
edit.nothingToRender: There is nothing on the timeline yet
edit.ownSoundNote: The clips carry their own sound too, so two things may be heard at once; turn one of them down in the cutting room.
edit.filmFresh: The film is the telling as it stands
edit.filmBehind: The film is behind the telling; exporting assembles it again first
edit.filmCarries: It carries {{voices}} readings, {{music}} pieces of music, and subtitles {{subtitles}}

import.name: Name
import.tooManyClips: This telling has more clips than one timeline holds ({{max}}). Film fewer acts, or fewer shots in each.

canvas.title: Import to canvas
canvas.hint: What this telling has generated so far becomes a board: the words, the drawings, the clips and the sound, each card carrying the ask it was made with and wired to what it came from
canvas.empty: The telling has generated nothing yet — nothing to import

timeline.title: Import to the cutting room
timeline.hint: A cut of its own is made from this telling's clips and sound, laid down in telling order. The telling keeps the timeline it assembled; this cut is yours to rearrange.
timeline.empty: No clip has been filmed yet — nothing to import
timeline.name: {{name}} · cut

voice.noLines: This act says nothing yet, so there is nothing to read out
voice.noSound: Write what this act sounds like on the board first
voice.instructions: Read it as a {{genre}} told in a {{style}} register — steady and unhurried, and no more dramatic than the lines are
voice.sample: This is a line read aloud, to hear whether the voice fits
voice.stale: The words changed since this was read
voice.saveFirst: Write the change down before reading it
voice.legacyNote: an older reading of the whole act
voice.audioFallback: The audio model here is what characters without a model of their own — and the narrator — fall back to. Each character's voice is set on the third step.
voice.fitsSped: {{over}}s longer than its shot · read {{speed}}× faster
voice.fitsOverrun: {{over}}s longer than its shot · read as fast as it may, {{spill}}s over the shot
voice.fitsUnmeasured: No measured length · laid at the shot's own length
